notes: Approved intent routing. INACTIVE while protocol.json authority=legacy: nothing dispatches from this file yet. Routing is a capability lookup — any registered role may send an intent to any other; it is not a requirement to ask the orchestrator for every hop. A mailbox entry alone never launches a runtime; missing execution capacity must leave a visible queued task. Fresh installs ship this inactive.
hop_rule: derived from the parent message; a caller-supplied hop is ignored when --parent is given

workspace.architecture.gate: truth gate + independent peer + human approval for structure execution

research.verify_source.gate: primary-source match, as-of date, no fabricated content

aeap.propose.gate: falsifiability, mechanism, lineage, no outcome access

aeap.execute.gate: isolation capability, resource budget, output invariants

aeap.reference_snapshot.gate: PIT timestamps, ownership, hashes, no future admits

aeap.evaluate.gate: independent run; all statistics from code; no repairs

aeap.red_team.gate: kill tests, sign, leakage, multiplicity, independence

aeap.admit.gate: every required check PASS + fence + expected library revision
aeap.admit.disabled_reason: no protected writer/evaluator isolation exists in this workspace; admission stays disabled per RFC P05

aeap.learn.gate: no invented status, no held-out leakage, no overwrite

aeap.publish.gate: OOS-only headline, costs, limitations, truthful null results

artifact.reconcile.gate: preserve originals; peer validates canonical choice

coord.contract_failure.gate: isolated fixture, no live destructive test
